issue: Discovery sweep confirms the Damerjog FLNG export project (POLY-GCL / GCL Technology Holdings; feed gas from Ethiopia's Ogaden Basin via the Ethiopia-Djibouti pipeline) is now definitively dead. On 28 June 2025 the Government of Ethiopia officially cancelled the planned Ogaden gas extraction and the LNG-export pipeline to Djibouti (first formal acknowledgment, in the Ethiopian Energy Outlook 2025), citing financing difficulties and slow implementation, and pivoted gas policy to domestic use (power generation, fertilizer). POLY-GCL's gas concession had already been revoked (Sep 2022), briefly reinstated (Jun 2024), then this June-2025 policy decision ended the export plan. GEM already carries the terminal as 'cancelled', so no lifecycle change is needed -- but the cancelled-status now has a concrete, sourced calendar anchor (June 2025) that GEM may want reflected (e.g. CancelledYear=2025 and a researcher_notes line citing the Ethiopian Energy Outlook 2025). No revival/successor sponsor found: GNE Hong Kong's Jul-2022 MOU was an investment intent in the SAME POLY-GCL project, not a new facility. fetch_timeline is down this batch, so routing as a qa note rather than a staged timeline edit.
